lines.trans: Camille, give me an explanation.
We have just lost Sacha Hartman and Isabelle Adjani.
The real problem is Camille.
She threw the screenplay in the trash.
Maybe she is a mole.
At the slightest doubt, she is out.
I am the one who asked her to lie.
I am the one who threw out this script.
Camille is my daughter.
Pardon? Your daughter?
When were you planning to tell us?
When the time came. Today, apparently.
She has been here for nine months!
You really made fools of us!
I take full responsibility.
If someone has to leave, it is me.
I completely agree.
